summary: Iteration 3 tested end to end with AUTH_ENABLED=true. Backend: 14 of 15 pytest tests pass (test_iter3_auth_roles.py). The failing test is brute-force lockout: it does not trigger reliably behind the ingress. Covered: login for every seeded account (bcrypt $2b$, httpOnly cookie), wrong password 401, register (terms required, duplicate 400), unverified 403, single-use verify token, pending 403 on /children, forgot/reset (sessions revoked, old password rejected), admin flows (validate needs a role, assign, revoke kills sessions and blocks login, reactivate, cannot edit self), audit entries, educator scope (Léo and Maya only, Noah 404, observations and levels), direction read-only (writes 403), internal ([] and stats; admin 403), seeded pending account, session revoke (other token 401) and Nano Banana avatar generation (~15s, image served from /api/avatars). Frontend: register, simulated link, verify, pending screen, forgot and reset all work in the UI. Also working: admin accounts (validate, revoke, reactivate; no controls on own row), assignment chips (the educator then sees Noah), audit log and its filter, educator /enfants (2 cards, tabs, click opens the overview for that child), overview score /100 and suggestions linking to the domain page, domain pages (emotionnel and cognitif: hero quote, ScoreRing, skills, activities, tabs, switch chips, level +/-, observation add/delete), avatar studio (gallery pick updates sidebar and tree trunk; AI generation updates the portrait and adds to Évolution), /futur scenarios, /interventions filter chips, direction UI (level +/-, add observation and new-child button hidden; quest steps and generate button disabled), internal landing on /interne for every route, /compte session revoke and logout. Regression passes: assistant streaming (Claude), AI quest generation, progress card, share add/remove.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout does not work reliably in production. The key is request.client.host + email, but behind the k8s ingress client.host is the ingress pod IP and it changes from request to request (seen: 10.201.1.194 and 10.201.4.160). Failed attempts are split across several buckets, so 6 to 8 bad attempts all return 401 and none returns 429. Fix: use the first IP of the X-Forwarded-For header (fall back to client.host), or count per email. The same wrong IP is stored in audit_logs.ip and in the session ip shown on /compte.

minor.issue: Once the 15-minute window is over, count stays at 5 or more. A single new failure then locks the account again for 15 minutes. Reset count when the window has expired.
update_child, set_level and other write endpoints call get_child twice, so each write creates a duplicate audit entry.
Served without authentication (unguessable uuid, cached for a year). Acceptable for an MVP, but these are child portraits; consider an auth check.
The seed restores only passwords, not status or role. If an admin revokes or changes a seeded account, it stays that way after restart. Fine, but document it.

ui_bugs.issue: Direction sees editable fields with an 'Enregistrer' button and the 'Nouveau profil / Ajouter le profil' form. Clicking Enregistrer gives a 403 that becomes an uncaught promise rejection (PAGEERROR 'Accès en lecture seule pour la direction') with no message shown to the user. Hide or disable these controls when !canWrite, and catch the errors.
avatar-history-* tiles call pick() even when canWrite is false, giving an unhandled 403. Disable them when !canWrite.
For the internal role the top bar still shows the 'Assistant IA' button, which does nothing (there is no child), plus search and notifications. The left sidebar is an empty panel.
After an avatar gallery pick or AI generation, the right-hand list still shows the old thumbnail until reload (profiles are not reloaded).

issues: Children assigned by the structure are labelled 'Partagé par Claire Admin', and the panel says 'vous pouvez observer, évaluer…', which is wrong for direction (read-only). Use wording such as 'Dossier attribué par la structure' and add a read-only notice for direction.
Shows the raw user-agent string and the ingress IP. Show a parsed browser/OS and the real IP (X-Forwarded-For).
The title and subtitle sit over the busiest part of the illustration and cover the character's head. The subtitle has low contrast; add a darker gradient behind the text.

action_items: Fix the brute-force identifier: use the X-Forwarded-For client IP (or email only) so 5 failures give a 429. Also use that IP for audit_logs and sessions.
Reset login_attempts count once the 15-minute window has expired.
Direction role: hide or disable the profile edit form, 'Ajouter le profil' and the Évolution tile picks; catch write errors and show a message.
Internal role: hide the Assistant IA button and the empty sidebar.
Reload profiles after an avatar change so the Profils suivis thumbnails update.
Optional: remove the duplicate audit entries caused by the double get_child call.
critical_code_review_comments: login(): ident = request.client.host is the proxy IP behind the ingress, which weakens the lockout.

login(): wrong-password failures are counted for users that do not exist too (fine), but a verified correct password clears the counter even when the account is then rejected as revoked or unverified. Acceptable.
forgot-password returns simulated_link null for unknown emails, so accounts can be enumerated in simulated mode (expected for the MVP; remove when real email is used).
server.py is 818 lines: split it into auth/admin/children/ai routers.
AdminPage revoke uses window.confirm. Fine, but tests must accept the dialog.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. test_iter3_* users, sessions, login_attempts, TEST_iter3 observations, AI messages and quests were removed. Seed assignments were restored (Léo and Maya assigned to seed_educ). Inès portrait was restored to the seed image, its avatar_history was cleared and the generated avatars were deleted. Child XP is back to 120.

It cleans up test_iter3_* users itself, but test_avatar_generate leaves an avatars doc for seed_ines and avatar_history entries: reset with mongo (avatars.delete_many child_id seed_ines; children.seed_ines avatar_history=[]). Admin revoke needs page.on('dialog', accept). Admin tab ids are accounts/assign/audit. Child switcher: select [data-testid=sidebar-child-switcher] by child_id. Avatar generation takes about 15s, quest generation about 10s, assistant streaming about 15s. AUTH_ENABLED=true is left on.
rca of the issue: Lockout: login_attempts docs showed identifier '10.201.1.194:email' count=5 and '10.201.4.160:email' count=3 for one client. request.client.host is the ingress pod, not the user, so the count is split. Reproduce: send 8 bad logins for one email via the public URL; they all return 401. Fix: ip = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip() or request.client.host.
